(4) The notice must—
(a) state what has been seized and the reason for its seizure;
(b) specify any offence which the o fficer believes has been committed;
(c) explain the effect of se ctions 49 to 51 and 53.

(5) The officer must make a reco rd of what has been seized.

(6) If a person who appears to a relevant enforcement officer to be an affected
person asks for a copy of that record, the officer must, within a reasonable time,
provide a copy of that record to that person.

47 Powers of entry, search and seizure: supplementary provision

(1) A relevant enforcement officer may use reasonable force, if necessary, for the
purpose of exercising any power conferred by sections 36 to 45.
